name: 引面
title: 傩童

skill.name: 捧面
skill.text: 每回合第一次戴上[面具]后，抽1张牌。

lore: 傩班里捧面具的孩子。她从不戴面具，因为她说，面具认得她的脸会哭。

art.subject: a little girl in silver robes carrying a tray of masks held high above her head, walking carefully

name: 鼓手
title: 傩鼓师

skill.name: 擂鼓
skill.text: 每当你[揭面]，获得4点[护甲]。

lore: 傩班的鼓点由他定。他说鬼听不懂人话，只听得懂鼓。

art.subject: a muscular drummer with bare arms beating a large red ritual drum, drumsticks blurred with motion

name: 神公
title: 掌坛师
lore: 主持傩坛的老法师，一辈子送走过无数疫鬼，也送走过无数亲人。

art.subject: an old ritual master in silver-white robes and a tall hat, raising a bell and a talisman before an altar

name: 科诨
title: 丑角

skill.name: 插科
skill.text: 每当你戴上[面具]，对随机敌人造成3点伤害。

lore: 戏里的丑角，专在最吓人的时候出来打诨。鬼被他逗笑了，就忘了害人。

art.subject: a grinning clown actor with a white patch painted on his nose, tumbling mid-somersault with a mask in hand
